title: Chapter 357
text:
Herlous slashed left and right happily. Suddenly, the enemy disappeared, and Han Xiao opened the door and walked in. "Why did you come in?" Herlous asked with confusion.

Han Xiao chuckled. "It's boring to train by yourself. Come, let's spar."

After reaching Grade B, he had not fought yet, so he was itching. He was a gentleman and would not bully the players for no reason. Coincidentally, Herlous was a veteran Grade B, so it would be meaningful to spar with him. Sparring with this old Grade B would make it easier for him to understand how strong he was.

Only by knowing his strength would he have the confidence to seek death … ahem, do things in the future.

"Spar?"

Herlous was speechless. He only had one thought in his mind. You?

The Grade of a Super was different from the cup size. The difference between C and B was like the difference between the earth and the earth. It was completely unequal in terms of combat strength. It would only be called a 'spar' if both sides were evenly matched.

Herlous was not too willing. He was so strong, and he could easily hurt Han Xiao if they fought.

However, thinking about it, Han Xiao's action was like the other members of the mercenary group. It should be called 'asking for guidance'. Herlous suddenly understood. So, that's what it meant. The captain wanted to ask for guidance from him.

"No problem. Do you need to prepare anything?" Herlous agreed generously with a relaxed expression. As the saying went, the one who was more capable would be the teacher. He was very happy to guide his friend. Furthermore, Han Xiao's safety was very important to him. If he could make Han Xiao stronger, he would be more at ease.

Han Xiao did not stand on ceremony at all. He told Herlous to wait for a while and moved boxes of mechanical equipment into the room. If he did not test all the weapons, he would not be able to face an opponent of the same grade.

Initially, Herlous was very calm, but when he saw more and more weapons, his face started to twitch. When Han Xiao moved a prototype of an electromagnetic railgun in, he could not help but gasp. "Hey, enough is enough!"

Under Herlous' protest, Han Xiao had no choice but to give up the idea of testing the upper limit of a Grade B Pugilist. He put on the Amphiptere mechanical suit and moved his limbs.

Melee combat was the strength of the Pugilist class, and the simulation room had limited space and was at a disadvantage. Therefore, before the fight started, Han Xiao opened up a certain distance and asked casually, "Are you ready?"

"You do it." Herlous was very calm. There was no need to prepare when dealing with an enemy who was one grade lower.

As soon as he said that, Han Xiao flipped his hands, and his leg armor slid open, revealing two electromagnetic pistols. He fired crazily, and the muzzle flashed with blue electric light. The sound was different from the sound of gunpowder, but it was a high-frequency buzzing sound with electric current. The needle bullets with a faint blue light poured toward Herlous, who was not far away.

The Battleship Slicing Blade was raised in time and blocked in front of him like a shield, making clanging sounds. Herlous' eyes changed slightly. "Electromagnetic guns?"

The core ability of a Mechanic was to create machines to fight. Being able to create electromagnetic guns meant that their attack power had reached a whole new level. The electromagnetic guns fired very quickly, and he almost could not react in time. Herlous did not dare be slow. Although he had energy to protect his body, his body was his after all. He did not want to be focused on at all.

Herlous did not know much about Mechanics, but he knew that only high-grade Mechanics could create more high-tech weapons. He was a little confused. Could a Grade C Mechanic create stable electromagnetic guns?

Herlous approached with his blade raised. His speed was much faster than a sports car. As he closed the distance, Han Xiao slid around and maintained his distance. There were many guns hidden under the armor. Pistols, assault rifles, and sniper rifles were all replaced with electromagnetic guns, which were much more lethal. The effect of long-range kiting was even more disgusting.

Herlous was indeed a Grade B. His reaction was very fast, and the wide Battleship Slicing Blade was suitable for blocking. Han Xiao fired hundreds of shots, but less than five percent of them hit. The damage was greatly reduced by the energy shield and strong bones of a Pugilist, so only some superficial wounds were caused. Han Xiao then saw Herlous' data interface.

LV 98, Grade B Pugilist, high in both Strength and Endurance. Half-tank Pugilist. He really has a lot of talents, almost as many as me. Plus, their effects are all very strong … Wow, this guy also has a low-level Luck Glow.

Han Xiao was very envious. According to Herlous' description, he had been very lazy since he was young, but he had extraordinary talents. He never trained hard, and after more than ten years of training, he still reached Grade B. Maybe this was talent …

Han Xiao could not help but think that if Herlous did not die like in the original plot, he might have reached Grade A.

"This is a stock with great potential."

This thought flashed through his mind. As his strength increased, Han Xiao's brain worked faster. He could think about other problems while fighting without being distracted. This time, Herlous suddenly stopped and did not chase anymore. The silver-white flames suddenly expanded, then contracted, and gathered in his palm, turning into a blinding silver-white light ball.

Boom!

Veins popped out on Herlous' face, and he seemed to be having a hard time. He roared and pushed his palm out. The light ball suddenly shot out, and energy continuously flowed out from his palm. A blinding silver-white light wave shot out like a roaring dragon, and the light filled Han Xiao 'vision.

Wow, a member of the Sun Family!

Han Xiao blocked with his hands. The next moment, the light wave hit his arms and sent him flying into the wall. The burst of light swallowed up his figure.

As long as a Pugilist learned the [Shockwave Blast] technique, they would be able to release waves. This was one of the Pugilist's Skill Tree abilities, just like the Mechanic's Knowledge Tree. It compressed energy into a ball, and its power depended on the energy level. The disadvantage was that it consumed a lot of energy.

There was a difference between waves. Compared to Grade C, Grade B waves were obviously thicker and longer lasting. Even if Herlous lowered his energy output for fear of breaking through the simulation room's walls, the rapidly rising temperature in the room showed the power of this attack.

This should be enough … No, why did I use this move?

Herlous was shocked. He originally had the intention of teaching Han Xiao, but because he felt a slight threat during the battle, he subconsciously treated Han Xiao as a great enemy and used a powerful attack. He immediately regretted it. Energy waves of this intensity could even injure Grade C Pugilists, let alone Mechanics.

Just as he was about to stop the energy output, a crescent-shaped lightning shot out from the center of the light wave and slashed the light wave apart!

Han Xiao leaped into the air with a ferocious black scythe in his hand. He descended and slashed down with the scythe. Electric Snake Tear!

Herlous immediately raised his blade to block. The scythe created a storm of sparks on the Battleship Slicing Blade, and the sound of metal rubbing against metal mixed with the sound of electricity. He stepped back and avoided the attack. He saw that Han Xiao, who had landed on the ground, had many parts of his body burned red by the light wave. White steam surrounded his body, and agile Mechanical Force electric snakes flowed all over his body. His energy reaction had risen to a shocking level.

Han Xiao twisted his neck and joked, "That was close. I almost couldn't take it." Although he said so, his tone was calm and full of energy. There were no signs of him being injured at all.

Herlous' eyes widened. To be able to take an energy wave head-on without being injured and still be able to release such an aura, there was no way he was just a Grade C.

"You're a Grade B Super?"

Herlous was stunned. You were not this strong when you were in Sunil!

Han Xiao shrugged and said, "I improved."

It had only been a few days, and he had already improved beyond his Grade! Could it be that you're more talented than me?

Herlous was dumbfounded. He had always known that his Endowment was very strong. Although he was not proud of it, seeing a Super who was more 'talented' than him now made him feel complicated.

"Don't stop. We're not done yet." Han Xiao reached out and grabbed the equipment box beside him. There was a magnetic connection between the mechanical suit's palm and the box. The box seemed to be summoned and flew toward him.

In midair, the box opened automatically, and the exoskeleton armor inside popped out. Following the position of the magnetic connection, it quickly floated over and covered Amphiptere. In the blink of an eye, it formed the [Siege Mode] of a metal giant.

Another benefit of Advanced Electromagnetism was that by adjusting the magnetic force of different parts, the equipment could be connected automatically. There was no need to manually put on clothes anymore, which increased the speed of putting on the armor.

Feeling the energy reaction from Han Xiao that made his heart tighten, Herlous' expression became serious. He adjusted his attitude and threw the idea of guiding him out of his mind.

"You're right. Our battle can be considered a spar!"

…
